_browser_comment: Every authorization request first lands on the fixture's own sign-in page (fapi2_conformance_server.rs login_gate), which never reaches the library until a button is pressed. Default flow: press Approve, then EITHER the AS redirects to the suite callback (wait for the implicitCallback page's id 'submission_complete') OR the AS refuses the request and the fixture renders its HTML 'Authorization error' page (fill the module's ExpectXxxErrorPage placeholder with update-image-placeholder). Both outcome tasks are optional because exactly one occurs per authorization. The 'override' block below replaces 'browser' for two modules whose summaries require a different human action: user-rejects-authentication presses Deny, and par-ensure-reused-request-uri-prior-to-auth-completion-succeeds takes no action on the first visit and presses Approve only on the second (the page marks a repeat showing with id 'revisit'). Per-module 'override' is the suite's own mechanism: info/DBTestPlanService.java merges override.<testName> into that module's config.

tasks.task: Sign-in page: press Approve (the fixture shows its own sign-in page in front of /authorize; see fapi2_conformance_server.rs login_gate)
Happy path: the AS redirects to the suite callback; wait for the suite's implicitCallback page to POST the response back (id 'submission_complete', 5s self-timeout fallback)

Rejection path: the AS correctly refused the authorization request (a reused / expired / wrong-client request_uri, or a request not sent via PAR) and the fixture served an HTML error page at its own origin with no callback to follow. Wait for that page and fill the module's ExpectXxxErrorPage placeholder from it (update-image-placeholder) so the WAITING test finishes instead of hanging until the plan timeout. The literal 'Authorization error' is the <h1> the fixture's authorization_errors_as_html renders on every 4xx at /authorize; command[1] MUST be a real selector (xpath), never match/contains, or BrowserControl never enters the placeholder-fill branch (BrowserControl.java doCommand @6b8b809).
Sign-in page: press DENY. This module's summary requires the user to reject the authentication or consent; the AS must answer access_denied at the redirect URI.
Happy path: the AS redirects to the suite callback; wait for the suite's implicitCallback page to POST the response back (id 'submission_complete', 5s self-timeout fallback)

Sign-in page: take NO action on the first visit (module summary: 'On the first visit no login should be attempted'); press Approve only when the page marks this request as already shown (id 'revisit'), i.e. on the second visit.
Happy path: the AS redirects to the suite callback; wait for the suite's implicitCallback page to POST the response back (id 'submission_complete', 5s self-timeout fallback)
